children.text: We stay involved because we built it. We monitor, improve, and optimize because products and technologies evolve every day. Keeping up with the pace of change will set your business up so you don't have to replatform every couple of years.

We stay involved because we know what we built and why we built it. As products, technologies, and business needs change, we monitor performance, improve the platform, and keep evolving the system with you.
The goal isn’t to replatform again in three years. It’s to build something capable of changing with you.

patches.before: Vertex takes the complexity out of tax for some of the world’s largest retailers. Its partner network, its products and its marketing were all growing at once.
patches.after: For more than a decade, we’ve helped Vertex evolve its global digital experience alongside its customers, products, and ambitions.

patches.before: Opportunity
patches.after: Overview

patches.before: Growth on three fronts at the same time
patches.after: A global business. A global tax problem. A lot to navigate.

children.text: A leading global provider of corporate tax software and services for some of the world’s largest retailers, Vertex aims to take the complexity out of sales and use tax, global taxation, and tax data for its customers. Vertex needed a partner to help them quickly and cohesively develop an evolving global customer experience. Their partner network was rapidly expanding, their products were maturing and their marketing needs were growing. They needed a team of nimble strategists, designers and technology experts that could manage and innovate across a complex digital marketing journey.

Vertex has grown from an emerging tax technology company into a global leader serving some of the world’s largest businesses. Along the way, its products matured, partner network expanded, audiences became more complex, and digital needs changed with them.

Our relationship evolved right alongside the business and has allowed us to move faster, challenge assumptions, and continually shape an experience that could keep pace with where the company was headed next.

patches.before: An assessment of Vertex’s market, data and customer journey came first.
patches.after: We combined ongoing research, analytics, journey mapping, and experimentation to understand changing customer needs and identify where the experience could create greater value.

patches.before: A personalized, multi-visit B2B experience, built to scale and nurture prospects across an organization.
patches.after: We evolved the experience across products, audiences, regions, and channels, creating more relevant pathways for prospects, partners, and existing customers.

patches.before: A globalized site carrying regional content, with several points of entry — a partner channel and automated chat among them.
patches.after: We helped establish a flexible global foundation that could support personalization, localization, marketing integration, and continued growth over time.
